name: Suspicious Berry Herbal Candy
desc: A Nod-Krai candy. Salty and astringent in a way you wouldn't expect from a candy, it hits so hard that anyone anticipating something sweet would howl in shock and dismay.

value.text: Increases all party members' Max HP by 20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
